use_cases.title: Browse and configure menu items
use_cases.goal: Select an available, suitable menu configuration for an order.
use_cases.trigger: The customer starts browsing the menu.
preconditions: The service is available for browsing.
use_cases.success_outcome: The customer has an accurately described configuration in the basket.

scenarios.title: Customer configures an item
steps: Customer browses published menu items.
Customer reviews product, dietary, allergen, and cross-contact information.
Customer selects allowed options and adds a valid configuration to the basket.

use_cases.title: Consider basket recommendations
use_cases.goal: Optionally add a compatible recommendation without changing the customer's choices automatically.
use_cases.trigger: The customer has a basket containing an eligible item.
preconditions: The customer has a basket.
use_cases.success_outcome: The customer keeps the basket or adds a compatible recommended item.

scenarios.title: Customer accepts or ignores a recommendation
steps: Customer sees eligible recommendations with their relevant information.
Customer may add one recommendation or continue without it.
The basket reflects only the customer's confirmed selections.

use_cases.title: Submit web pickup order
use_cases.goal: Place a feasible guest pickup order.
use_cases.trigger: The customer chooses to check out a basket.
preconditions: The customer has a valid basket.
use_cases.success_outcome: A feasible order is submitted with its pickup commitment and required contact data.

scenarios.title: Customer submits a feasible order
steps: Customer begins checkout and receives feasible pickup opportunities.
Customer provides the required order contact data and selects a pickup opportunity.
Customer submits the order.
Customer receives the resulting order status and pickup commitment.

scenarios.title: Final availability changes
steps: Customer submits the order.
The requested opportunity is no longer feasible.
Customer receives the nearest feasible alternatives without a confirmed order being created.

use_cases.title: Respond to a revised pickup commitment
use_cases.goal: Accept or decline a material pickup-time proposal through private tracking.
use_cases.trigger: The customer receives a proposed alternative pickup time or important revised estimate.
preconditions: The customer has private access to the affected order.
use_cases.success_outcome: The customer's response is reflected in the order's operational handling.

scenarios.title: Customer responds to proposal
steps: Customer opens private order tracking.
Customer reviews the proposed pickup change.
Customer accepts or declines within the response window.
The order reflects the response.

scenarios.title: Customer does not respond
steps: The response window expires without a customer response.
The order is routed for the defined safe handling and the customer receives the applicable outcome.

use_cases.title: Register assisted pickup order
use_cases.goal: Record a telephone or in-person pickup order in the same operational flow as a web order.
use_cases.trigger: A customer asks staff to place an order by telephone or in person.
preconditions: The staff member is authorised for operational order entry.
use_cases.success_outcome: The assisted order enters the ordinary order lifecycle with a feasible pickup opportunity.

scenarios.title: Staff records assisted order
steps: Staff receives the customer's requested items and pickup needs.
Staff records the order and provides the next feasible pickup opportunity.
The order enters the shared operational queue with its origin recorded.

use_cases.title: Control online ordering mode
use_cases.goal: Set the online ordering mode appropriate to current service conditions.
use_cases.trigger: An authorised staff member needs to change online order admission.
preconditions: The staff member is authorised for operational order control.
use_cases.success_outcome: Online ordering uses the selected safe admission mode.

scenarios.title: Staff member changes ordering mode
steps: Staff member reviews current operating conditions.
Staff member selects the permitted ordering mode.
Online ordering follows the selected mode.

use_cases.title: Review pending web order
use_cases.goal: Resolve a pending web order under the selected manual-review mode.
use_cases.trigger: A web order enters manual review.
preconditions: The staff member is authorised to review pending orders.
use_cases.success_outcome: The pending order has a recorded operational decision and the customer receives the applicable outcome.

scenarios.title: Staff member reviews pending order
steps: Staff member reviews the pending order and its feasible pickup opportunity.
Staff member accepts, rejects, or proposes a feasible alternative pickup time.
The resulting decision is recorded for the customer and operations.

use_cases.title: Modify existing order after telephone request
use_cases.goal: Apply an authorised customer-requested change to an existing order and revalidate it.
use_cases.trigger: A customer makes a later telephone request to change an existing order.
preconditions: The existing order is in a state that permits the requested operational change.
use_cases.success_outcome: The order reflects the authorised revalidated change and the customer receives the resulting outcome.

scenarios.title: Staff member modifies existing order
steps: Customer makes a later telephone request to change an existing order.
Staff member applies the permitted change and revalidates the applicable operational consequences.
Staff member communicates the revalidated outcome to the customer.

use_cases.title: Manage service schedule and capacity
use_cases.goal: Maintain feasible service dates, pickup windows, capacity, and temporary service controls.
use_cases.trigger: An authorised actor prepares or adjusts service operations.
preconditions: The actor has the required operational authority for the requested adjustment.
use_cases.success_outcome: Order admission uses the current approved service schedule and capacity.

scenarios.title: Jaime manages normal service schedule and capacity
steps: Jaime reviews the planned service period.
Jaime sets or adjusts normal operating hours, windows, and capacity.
Future order admission reflects the resulting feasible opportunities.

scenarios.title: Authorised staff applies temporary current-service adjustment
steps: Authorised staff member reviews current-service conditions.

Authorised staff member blocks or reopens individual pickup windows or, when acting as responsible person, applies a permitted temporary preparation delay or capacity reduction limited to the current service.
Order admission reflects the temporary current-service adjustment.

use_cases.title: Prepare and progress an order
use_cases.goal: Receive an accepted order, prepare it, and progress it through the kitchen lifecycle.
use_cases.trigger: An order enters the kitchen queue.
preconditions: The staff member has an active operational session.
use_cases.success_outcome: The order's current preparation status is visible and accurate.

scenarios.title: Staff prepares an accepted order
steps: Staff receives and acknowledges the order in the kitchen queue.
Staff starts preparation and progresses the order as work completes.
Staff marks the order ready for collection and the applicable customer notification is sent.

use_cases.title: Manage stock and availability
use_cases.goal: Keep products and options saleable only when they are available and sufficiently stocked.
use_cases.trigger: Staff needs to review, adjust, or restrict saleability.
preconditions: The staff member has operational access.
use_cases.success_outcome: Current availability and stock safely constrain new sales.

scenarios.title: Staff updates saleability
steps: Staff reviews a product or option's availability and stock condition.
Staff applies an authorised adjustment or restriction.
New sales reflect the updated condition.

use_cases.title: Maintain published catalog
use_cases.goal: Maintain accurate approved catalog content and configured product options.
use_cases.trigger: The responsible person needs to create or change catalog information.
preconditions: The responsible person is authorised to administer the catalog.
use_cases.success_outcome: Published catalog content is approved, complete, and historically safe.

scenarios.title: Responsible person publishes catalog change
steps: Responsible person enters reviewed catalog content or options.
Responsible person confirms the information is complete and approved.
The eligible catalog content becomes available for customer browsing.

use_cases.title: Respond to food-safety information issue
use_cases.goal: Stop unsafe sales and protect affected orders when food-safety information is wrong.
use_cases.trigger: A staff member identifies an allergen, dietary, or cross-contact discrepancy.
preconditions: The discrepancy concerns a published product or option.
use_cases.success_outcome: Affected sales are safely restricted and affected accepted orders receive operational review.

scenarios.title: Staff isolates unsafe sale
steps: Staff identifies incorrect safety information or an unsafe operating condition.
Staff disables the affected sale and alerts the responsible person.
Affected accepted orders are made visible for operational review.

use_cases.title: Track order privately
use_cases.goal: Follow the order lifecycle through a private customer view.
use_cases.trigger: The customer uses the private tracking access received after order submission.
preconditions: The customer has valid private tracking access.
use_cases.success_outcome: The customer sees the current material order and pickup status without obtaining general order-editing access.

scenarios.title: Customer views order status
steps: Customer opens the private tracking access.
Customer views the current order status and material pickup estimate.
Customer leaves the tracking view without changing the order.

use_cases.title: Collect payment and hand over order
use_cases.goal: Complete payment at collection and hand over a ready order.
use_cases.trigger: A customer arrives to collect a ready order.
preconditions: The order is ready for collection.
use_cases.success_outcome: Payment and handover are separately recorded and the customer receives the order.

scenarios.title: Staff completes collection
steps: Staff identifies the order and confirms the person collecting it.
Staff records the payment actually received.
Staff records handover and provides the applicable receipt.

use_cases.title: Handle non-collection
use_cases.goal: Resolve an order that remains uncollected after its confirmed pickup window.
use_cases.trigger: The confirmed pickup window and applicable grace period pass without collection.
preconditions: The order remains uncollected after its confirmed pickup window.
use_cases.success_outcome: The order has the authorised non-collection outcome and a recorded operational history.

scenarios.title: Staff member handles non-collection
steps: Staff member attempts customer contact after the confirmed pickup window and applicable grace period.
Staff member manually records the order as not collected, or records an authorised extension within its maximum.
The order remains available for the resulting operational handling.

use_cases.title: Close service shift
use_cases.goal: Review the operational shift, reconcile cash, and close active sessions.
use_cases.trigger: A team member ends a service shift.
preconditions: Service is ready to close.
use_cases.success_outcome: The shift close is recorded with its required reviews and unresolved matters.

scenarios.title: Team member closes shift
steps: Team member reviews open orders, payments, and unresolved incidents.
Team member reconciles cash and records any explanation.
Team member confirms the shift close and ends the operational session.

use_cases.title: Resolve operational incident
use_cases.goal: Safely resolve an order, contact, delay, payment, or fulfilment exception while preserving history.
use_cases.trigger: An order or operational issue needs staff attention.
preconditions: The issue is visible to authorised staff.
use_cases.success_outcome: The incident has a recorded safe resolution or an explicit escalation.

scenarios.title: Staff resolves an incident
steps: Staff opens the item requiring attention.
Staff contacts the customer or applies an authorised safe measure.
Staff records the resolution, or escalates the unresolved decision.

use_cases.title: Handle pending Jaime decision
use_cases.goal: Record and revisit a decision that staff cannot resolve within authorised rules.
use_cases.trigger: An operational issue exceeds staff authority.
preconditions: A safe interim measure has been identified.
use_cases.success_outcome: The pending decision remains visible until Jaime resolves it.

scenarios.title: Jaime resolves pending decision
steps: Staff records the pending-Jaime decision and safe interim measure.
Jaime reviews the pending decision.
Jaime records the resolution.

use_cases.title: Open accountable service
use_cases.goal: Open online service only under an identified responsible person.
use_cases.trigger: A responsible person begins a service period.
preconditions: The person is Jaime or an authorised delegate.
use_cases.success_outcome: The service responsibility is recorded and ordering may operate within its configured mode.

scenarios.title: Responsible person assumes service responsibility
steps: Responsible person confirms responsibility for the service period.
The responsibility record is created.
Online ordering becomes eligible to open under the selected operating mode.

use_cases.title: Manage staff access and delegation
use_cases.goal: Maintain authorised operational access and responsibility delegation.
use_cases.trigger: Jaime needs to grant, review, or revoke access.
preconditions: Jaime is authorised to manage staff access.
use_cases.success_outcome: Staff access and delegation are current, bounded, and attributable.

scenarios.title: Jaime manages staff access
steps: Jaime reviews the staff member's required role and limits.
Jaime records the authorised access or delegation change.
The staff member receives only the permitted access.

use_cases.title: Review operational reports
use_cases.goal: Review controlled operational and pilot evidence for service decisions.
use_cases.trigger: The responsible person conducts a scheduled review.
preconditions: The responsible person has report access.
use_cases.success_outcome: The responsible person can evaluate the defined operational evidence.

scenarios.title: Responsible person reviews service report
steps: Responsible person opens the authorised report.
Responsible person reviews the defined operational measures.
Responsible person records or acts on the resulting operational decision where needed.

use_cases.title: Prepare and operate controlled pilot
use_cases.goal: Run the controlled rollout only after its prerequisites are met and pause it safely when critical conditions occur.
use_cases.trigger: The responsible person prepares or operates the pilot.
preconditions: Pilot work is authorised within its current validation gates.
use_cases.success_outcome: Pilot activity follows its approved controls and produces the required evidence.

scenarios.title: Responsible person runs controlled pilot activity
steps: Responsible person verifies the pilot's current prerequisites and controls.
Staff and responsible person conduct the approved pilot activity.
The pilot is measured and paused or progressed only under its defined conditions.
